title: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha Protests Outside Congress HQ
seoTitle: Delhi BJP Women Protest Congress HQ

tea.why: Protesters accused Congress leaders of misbehaving with women police personnel during earlier protests.
tea.want: Demanding a public apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi.
tea.changed: Oct 8: BJP Mahila Morcha members marched near the Congress headquarters and staged a sit-in before being stopped by police.

summary: On October 8, the Delhi unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party's Mahila Morcha organized a protest near the Congress headquarters at Indira Bhawan in New Delhi. Led by figures including general secretary Yogita Singh, Aarti Mehra, and Archana Gupta, the participants marched from the Andhra Bhawan red light and raised slogans demanding an apology from Congress MP Rahul Gandhi. The demonstration was held in response to alleged misconduct by Congress leaders against women police personnel during prior protests on Tuesday and Wednesday. Police established a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan and forcibly halted the marchers, who then staged a sit-in before being warned and allowed to leave.
demands: Immediate public apology from Rahul Gandhi
response: Police formed a heavy human barricade and forcibly stopped the march, allowing protesters to leave after a sit-in.

updates.text: The Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha staged a protest march towards the Congress office at Indira Bhawan.
Police formed a heavy barricade and stopped the protesters, who then held a sit-in before dispersing.
